node.statement: For xi in icalH set P=DF_s(A)xi and R=DQ(A)xi. Differentiating the exact identity in node 1.7 gives -xi+DG(A)xi=P+DG(B)P+R+E, where E=(P+DG(B)P) bold-dot Q+(B+G(B)) bold-dot R. Splitting anti-Hermitian and Hermitian parts gives P+xi=-P^par(E) and R=DG(A)xi-DG(B)P-P^perp(E).
